selected_local_item: Toyota Land Cruiser 70-series diesel radiator, preferably HZJ75/HZJ78/HZJ79/1HZ
supplier: Bilal Ganj/Montgomery Road/Land Cruiser parts suppliers
required_proof_before_payment: Photos of radiator; donor identity as genuine 70-series diesel; part numbers or markings if present; price; return/exchange terms; new preferred or clean undamaged used acceptable
reject_if: Small-car substitute; not actually 70-series diesel; leaking rotten crushed badly repaired or damaged plastic tanks; no return/exchange if wrong after trial fit
installation_role: Rear heat exchanger in front stack; owner/fabricator will design two-sided rubber-isolated cradle after parts are in hand

selected_local_item: Custom HJ47/2H pattern radiator built or recored from old sample
buy_decision: Fallback if 70-series donor radiator is unavailable or poor
required_proof_before_payment: Old sample on counter; overall width/height/thickness; core width/height/thickness; hose neck side and OD; cap/overflow/drain positions; corrected left/right mount tabs; pressure/flow test result; warranty
reject_if: Shop copies the bad one-sided support leg; no pressure test; wrong necks/brackets; radiator is used as condenser/fan structure
installation_role: Fallback rear heat exchanger in front stack; mounted on rubber-isolated frame tabs

selected_local_item: Matching Toyota Land Cruiser 70-series A/C condenser from the same HZJ75/HZJ78/HZJ79/1HZ donor family
supplier: Bilal Ganj/Montgomery Road/Land Cruiser parts suppliers
required_proof_before_payment: Photos of condenser; donor identity as matching 70-series A/C part; part numbers or markings if present; port condition; price; return/exchange terms
reject_if: Small-car substitute; broken ports; oil-stained or badly smashed fins/tubes; seller cannot identify donor or accept return/exchange
installation_role: Forward heat exchanger in front stack; owner/fabricator will design mounting spacing and hose routing after parts are in hand

selected_local_item: Hilux Vigo/Revo diesel, Kia Sportage, or universal parallel-flow condenser fallback
required_proof_before_payment: Seller photos of overall width/height/thickness; fitting side; inlet/outlet size/thread; bracket/tab positions; proof it is parallel-flow/R134a suitable; fins straight and no oil stains
reject_if: Tube-fin or unknown construction; bent tubes/fins; no fitting data; too wide/tall for upright opening; seller wants through-fin mounting rods
installation_role: Forward heat exchanger in front stack; mounted to separate rubber-isolated condenser tabs

selected_local_item: Alto Pakistani 660cc condenser from Snow Cool/Arsalan
required_proof_before_payment: Use only if the front opening cannot accept the 70-series or larger fallback condenser; seller tape photos; pressure test; fitting proof
reject_if: Chosen for convenience while larger condenser fits; too small for hot-weather load; no fitting data
installation_role: Fallback condenser package; may need stronger fan and careful charge testing

selected_local_item: Slim 12V pusher condenser fan assembly, 12-14 inch, complete with blade/shroud/mount feet
buy_decision: Buy after condenser dimensions are locked
required_proof_before_payment: Diameter, depth, current draw, blade direction, pusher airflow proof, mounting foot layout, grille clearance with bonnet shut
reject_if: Motor-only without blade/shroud; puller-only fan that cannot be reversed; fan tied through condenser fins; current draw unknown
installation_role: Mounted on fan hoop/crossbar ahead of condenser, not through fins

selected_local_item: New R134a receiver-drier with matched O-ring ports and switch port
supplier: Snow Cool driers or Arsalan receiver driers
buy_decision: Buy with final condenser/hose fitting set
required_proof_before_payment: Sealed caps still fitted; flow arrow; inlet/outlet thread/port size; binary/trinary switch port thread; bracket/clamp size; fresh unused stock
reject_if: Open/unsealed drier; no pressure-switch provision unless switch is installed elsewhere; flare/O-ring mismatch; old stock with corrosion
installation_role: Mounted vertical on side upright after condenser outlet and before TXV/evaporator feed

selected_local_item: Binary or trinary A/C pressure switch matched to drier or high-side service block
buy_decision: Required before compressor clutch wiring is released
required_proof_before_payment: Thread matches drier/switch port; normally-open/normally-closed logic identified; pressure ratings; connector pigtail available
reject_if: Random vehicle switch with unknown thread/logic; no way to wire low-pressure and high-pressure clutch cutout
installation_role: Protects compressor from no charge and excessive head pressure

selected_local_item: R134a barrier hose set with crimp fittings, service ports, and HNBR O-rings
required_proof_before_payment: Match actual compressor head, condenser ports, drier ports, TXV/evaporator ports; #6 liquid line, #8 discharge, #10 suction where applicable; protected firewall pass-through; nitrogen leak check
reject_if: Hydraulic hose or fuel hose; crimped before component positions are locked; wrong O-ring/flare standard; hose touching belts/fan/exhaust
installation_role: Connects compressor, condenser, drier, evaporator, and service ports

selected_local_item: Hose and pipe fitting quote with nitrogen leak check
buy_decision: Quality fallback if local A/C shop cannot prove hose/fitting work
required_proof_before_payment: Confirm they will build to the actual sample/fitting set; crimp and nitrogen leak-check finished hoses; provide pigtails/adapters if needed
reject_if: No custom hose service available; no leak-check; fittings do not match compressor head or selected drier
installation_role: Same hose role as primary hose row

selected_local_item: Reuse installed Sanden-type compressor on 2H bracket; local replacement only if it fails gate
supplier: Existing vehicle; replacement quote from Arsalan/Sanpak
buy_decision: Reuse first, replace only if failed
required_proof_before_payment: 12V clutch; V-belt pulley/groove alignment; suction/discharge port style; R134a oil plan; shaft seal/port leak test; bracket not cracked
reject_if: 24V compressor on 12V vehicle; wrong pulley offset; unknown oil after failed system; shaft seal leak; no pressure switch protection
installation_role: Compressor discharge feeds condenser; suction returns from evaporator

selected_local_item: Hang on 228 12V under-dash unit from Arsalan Autos
buy_decision: Local fallback cabin unit if hidden evaporator package is rejected
required_proof_before_payment: Case width/height/depth; drain nipple; TXV/fittings; blower current; outlet face; mounting tabs; under-dash cardboard mock-up
reject_if: Bulky visible hang-on unit rejected by cabin design; no drain path; fittings conflict with firewall; blower draw exceeds wiring plan
installation_role: Cabin-side evaporator/blower; not part of front frame but required for complete A/C loop

selected_local_item: 50 x 50 x 4 mm mild-steel angle plus 3-4 mm tab/gusset plate
required_proof_before_payment: Tape/caliper proof of 4 mm thickness; straight stock; enough length for both full-height uprights and tabs; weldable mild steel
reject_if: 2 mm angle; aluminium angle; twisted or deeply pitted stock; closed rust traps added without drain/access
installation_role: Structural uprights, tabs, crossbars, drier clamp, and fan hoop

selected_local_item: EPDM rubber washers/pads and crush-tube/spacer hardware
required_proof_before_payment: Rubber pad thickness; washer OD/ID; bolt grade; crush tube length where boxed chassis sections are clamped
reject_if: Hard-mounted radiator/condenser tabs; soft rubber that extrudes under bolt load; no crush tubes where needed
installation_role: Isolates radiator and condenser tabs from frame vibration
